CustomField.description: Concatenates Line of Business and RecordType Name for Conga
CustomField.formula: IF(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Churn","Churn", IF( OR( CONTAINS(Service_Offering_Rollup_Abbr__c,"Salesforce"), CONTAINS(Service_Offering_Rollup_Abbr__c, "Zingly"), CONTAINS(Service_Offering_Rollup_Abbr__c, "HubSpot")), "Salesforce"&RecordType.Name, IF( !ISBLANK(Service_Offering_Rollup_Abbr__c), "Core"&RecordType.Name,"")))
CustomField.label: LOB - Record Type
